title: For teams with 'Normal' build-up play dribbling class in the 2015/2016 seas
question: For teams with 'Normal' build-up play dribbling class in the 2015/2016 season, identify which country's league had the most matches where these teams played as the home team and the match ended in a draw. List the country name and the count of such matches.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c."XCL_002" AS country_name, COUNT(m."XCL_006") AS match_count
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON c."XCL_001" = m."XCL_007"
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON m."XCL_013" = ta."XCL_177"
WHERE ta."XCL_182" = 'Normal'
  AND m."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
  AND m."XCL_015" = m."XCL_016"
GROUP BY c."XCL_002"
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT c."XCL_002" AS country_name, COUNT(m."XCL_006") AS match_count
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON c."XCL_001" = m."XCL_007"
JOIN Team t ON m."XCL_013" = t."XCL_171"
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t."XCL_171" = ta."XCL_177"
WHERE ta."XCL_182" = 'Normal'
  AND m."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
  AND m."XCL_015" = m."XCL_016"
GROUP BY c."XCL_002"
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1
